title: If you’re looking for the most fun you can have on Broadway right now...
transcript: If you love glamorous women, unhinged, heated rivalries and a little theatrical witchcraft, stop scrolling. Here are three reasons you need to see death becomes her on broadway. One, it's the ultimate best friend or favourite frenemy night out. Because this show centres two lifelong best frenemies, madeline and helen, who are locked in a glorious diva off of revenge, vanity and immortality holiday. Your friends will be talking about the drama for years to come. Two, the performances are next level iconic. This show is a master class in comedy from some of broadway's best leading ladies. I got to see betsy wolff and dario oliver and I laughed so hard I cried. Every cast combination is giving you insane vocals, razor sharp timing and fearless physical comedy. And three, the four is one of the best in musical theatre right now. It's original, hilarious, wildly catchy, and you'll be listening to it long after the curtain call. Death becomes her is one of the most entertaining nights on broadway. You gotta see it.
reasoning: The reviewer gives an unequivocal, enthusiastic recommendation with three strong reasons to see the show. They praise the performances ('next level iconic,' 'laughed so hard I cried'), the score ('one of the best in musical theatre right now'), and call it 'one of the most entertaining nights on broadway' with a direct 'you gotta see it' closing.
